fn factorial_func(num: Int) -> Int
  requires (num >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (num <= 1) then 1 else (num * factorial_func((num - 1)))))
  effects pure
  example (factorial_func(0) == 1)
  example (factorial_func(2) == 2)
{
  if (num <= 1) then 1 else (num * factorial_func((num - 1)))
}

fn special_factorial_func(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n <= 0) then 1 else (special_factorial_func((n - 1)) * factorial_func(n))))
  effects pure
  example (special_factorial_func(0) == 1)
  example (special_factorial_func(2) == 2)
{
  if (n <= 0) then 1 else (special_factorial_func((n - 1)) * factorial_func(n))
}

fn special_factorial(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == special_factorial_func(n))
  ensures (result > 0)
  effects pure
